skeptical-audit.why: this change is the skill's own discipline turned on the skill's own doc: an overstatement (claim-lint --strict described as already a blocking CI gate) is corrected to match the evidence, since claim-lint.mjs ships as a helper (classified bootstrap-v2-helper in ADR-0109, not in gate-manifest.json and not run in CI).
skeptical-audit.what: rewrote the 'becomes proven when' cell so it states the CI-gate wiring as a not-yet condition and names the current reality (ships as a helper today), removing the asserted-but-ungrounded present-tense claim; verified no other line in the file still overclaims.
quotes: If you cannot attach all three, you do not assert it

judge-arch.why: the change edits a skill's governing doc, so it got a fresh-context review of every changed file against the four questions, with the accuracy of the new wording (and whether any other line still overclaims) as the adversarial focus.
judge-arch.what: dispatched a fresh-context subagent review of the one-line diff and the changelog fragment; it verified claim-lint is a helper and the correction introduces no new inaccuracy; the review entry is recorded in docs/arch-reviews/entries/.
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all of them.
